q1.q: Is CyberSec Pro legal to use?
q1.a: Yes. CyberSec Pro is designed for authorized security testing only. You must have explicit written permission to scan any target. Unauthorized testing is illegal and violates our Terms of Service.

q2.q: Do I need to install anything?
q2.a: No. Everything runs in your browser — no local installation, no VMs, no configuration. Just sign up, add a target, and start scanning.

q3.a: CyberSec Pro provides 87 Kali Linux tools across 14 categories, including Nmap, Metasploit, Burp Suite, SQLMap, Nikto, Hydra, and many more. Tool availability depends on your plan tier.

q4.a: We offer Quick Scan (top 20 tools, 5-15 min), Full Scan (all tools in your plan, 1-4 hours), Custom Scan (hand-picked tools with custom parameters), and Scheduled Scan (recurring daily/weekly/monthly).

q5.a: We support PDF, HTML, JSON, CSV, and Markdown formats. All reports include CVSS scoring, remediation guidance, and compliance mapping (OWASP, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST).

q6.a: Absolutely. All data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Our controls are designed to align with SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, and we never share your scan results with third parties.

q7.q: Can I use it for my company?
q7.a: Yes. Professional and Enterprise plans include team collaboration, multi-tenant workspaces, role-based access controls (Owner, Admin, Analyst), and centralized billing.

q8.a: Before scanning, you must verify target ownership via DNS TXT record, HTTP file upload, or HTML meta tag. This prevents unauthorized scanning and ensures compliance with security testing laws.

q9.q: What happens if a scan finds vulnerabilities?
q9.a: Each vulnerability is categorized by CVSS severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info) with detailed remediation steps, affected components, and references to CVE databases. You can export findings directly to your ticketing system.

q10.q: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
q10.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No long-term contracts.

q11.a: Yes. Our REST API supports 130+ endpoints for programmatic access to scans, results, reports, and team management. Available on Starter plans and above with full API documentation.

q12.a: CyberSec Pro maps findings to OWASP Top 10 (2021), PCI-DSS v4.0, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls v8, MITRE ATT&CK, SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR frameworks.

dataResidency.title: Data Residency & Privacy
dataResidency.subtitle: Your data stays in Canada. Always.
dataResidency.storageDescription: All customer data, scan results, and logs are stored exclusively in Canadian data centers. No data leaves Canadian jurisdiction without explicit customer consent.
dataResidency.encryptionDescription: All data is encrypted using AES-256-GCM with unique per-tenant keys. Key rotation occurs every 90 days. Keys are stored in a hardware security module (HSM).
dataResidency.encryptionInTransitDescription: All API and web traffic uses TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy. Cipher suites are restricted to the strongest available configurations.
dataResidency.noLoggingDescription: We do not log, store, or process raw network traffic or scan payloads. Only metadata (timestamps, target IPs, tool types, severity counts) is retained for operational purposes.
dataResidency.noLoggingPolicy3: No personal data in scan results
dataResidency.dataProcessing1: Purpose limitation — data collected only for stated security scanning purposes
dataResidency.dataProcessing2: Data minimization — we collect the minimum data necessary
dataResidency.dataProcessing3: Transparency — you always know what data we store and why
dataResidency.dataProcessing4: User control — you can export or delete your data at any time
